_comment: Example arm for scripts/run-arm.js. Units are the contract's: fee is hundredths of a bip, ticks are V3
ticks in POOL orientation, every amount is RAW base units, seedQuoteWei is wei of WETH.
This cell is ARM ZERO: the reference pad's exact geometry (fee 10000, opening tick 206800, range
[46000, 206800], 1e27 tokens, ZERO quote, no dev buy). It exists to prove the rig reproduces the
population's modal launch before any variable is moved. Copy it and change ONE field per arm.
declareExperiment(keccak256('seed-quote-sweep'), ...) must already have fired in an EARLIER transaction
or run-arm.js refuses to send anything.
